01 — About

Bridging visual craft and business outcomes.

I'm Mohamad Kameh, a mid-level UI/UX designer with over 3 years of experience crafting modern, user-centered digital products and high-converting Shopify e-commerce platforms. Figma-certified, I combine deep technical expertise in design systems and interactive prototyping with an intuitive grasp of brand aesthetics, user flows, and conversion optimization.

Throughout my career — working with agencies like OLA and SS Solutions, as well as managing end-to-end client work as a freelancer — I've bridged the gap between visual craft and business outcomes. My experience spans full store setups, custom Shopify theme implementations, and responsive web/mobile interfaces. I also leverage AI video tools including Runway, Kling, Seedance, and ElevenLabs to produce high-impact visual advertising for modern brands.

Whether designing complex fintech concepts or launching regional e-commerce stores, I focus on creating polished, accessible, and intuitive digital experiences that resonate with users and drive measurable results.

▸ Frame — NIMO / Landing Page
1440 × 3200

NIMO — Institutional Crypto Exchange Landing Page

UI/UX Concept
Web · Figma

A concept landing page for an institutional cryptocurrency exchange — establishing trust, communicating complex financial services clearly, and presenting a premium experience for professional investors.

Type
UI/UX Concept
Platform
Web
Tools
Figma
Audience
Institutional investors

The challenge: institutional financial platforms often present large amounts of technical information that can overwhelm first-time visitors. The goal was to simplify complex concepts while maintaining a premium appearance that conveys credibility, security, and professionalism — for institutional investors, hedge funds, financial firms, and enterprise clients exploring digital asset solutions.

Problems identified

  • Financial information lacked clear visual hierarchy
  • Trust indicators weren't immediately visible
  • Dense content reduced readability
  • Navigation needed to support quick access to key info

Goals

  • Create a modern, trustworthy visual identity
  • Improve content organization and readability
  • Highlight security and institutional credibility
  • Guide users toward primary conversion actions

Design decisions

A dark visual theme reinforces the premium, technology-focused identity while letting key interface elements stand out through contrast. Content is grouped into clearly defined sections to reduce cognitive load, with spacing, typography, and hierarchy balanced for readability. Interactive elements are subtle yet engaging.

Premium fintech interface Clear information hierarchy Trust & security sections Responsive layout Modular content sections

"A professional landing page that communicates trust, innovation, and usability — presenting complex financial services in a way that's approachable and easy to navigate."

What I learnedBalancing visual sophistication with clarity — and how information architecture and consistency build user confidence on products handling complex financial services.
▸ Frame — PrimeForce / Shopify Store
1440 × 4100

PrimeForce — Fitness & Activewear E-Commerce Store

Shopify Store
Web / Mobile · Figma, Shopify

A conversion-driven Shopify store for an activewear and fitness apparel brand, with structured product collections for men and women, clear visual hierarchy, and a high-energy athletic identity.

Type
Shopify Store
Platform
Web & Mobile
Tools
Figma, Shopify
Audience
Gym-goers, athletes

Activewear stores compete in a saturated market where brand image and friction-free shopping are critical. The core challenge was designing a store that communicates strength and quality through dynamic imagery, while organizing varied product lines — men's shorts, hoodies, women's crop tops, duffle bags — into an intuitive browsing experience.

Problems identified

  • High product volume needed visual organization
  • Inconsistent layouts created visual clutter
  • Navigation friction between Men's / Women's / Equipment
  • Missed CTA opportunities on hero and category pages

Goals

  • High-impact hero banner with a clear "Shop Now" CTA
  • Intuitive collection pages with granular filtering
  • Standardized product card layouts across categories
  • Responsive, mobile-first design built for conversion

Design decisions

A dark theme paired with high-contrast text and vibrant highlight colors aligns with the bold aesthetics of modern gym apparel. Header navigation stays clean and focused — primary categories front and center alongside search, account, and cart. Product cards use uniform aspect ratios to keep flat-lay and modeled shots consistent across the grid.

High-impact hero banner Structured category browsing Product card grid Multi-currency (USD/LBP) Responsive mobile nav

"A bold, cohesive storefront — combining crisp visual design with structured navigation to reduce friction from landing to product selection."

What I learnedConsistent product imagery presentation heavily shapes user perception — balancing rich hero visuals with clean, distraction-free grids keeps users engaged toward checkout.
▸ Frame — ShopWise LB / Multi-Category Store
1440 × 3800

ShopWise LB — Modern Multi-Category E-Commerce Store

Shopify Store
Web / Mobile · Figma, Shopify

A regional lifestyle e-commerce platform for Lebanon, positioning ShopWise LB as a trusted local shopping destination with a distinct blue-to-purple gradient identity and rapid direct-purchase flows.

Type
Shopify Store
Platform
Web & Mobile
Tools
Figma, Shopify
Audience
LB online shoppers

Multi-product lifestyle stores often struggle with visual consistency due to widely varying product photography and broad catalog scope — from children's items to tech accessories. The challenge was structuring a cohesive, premium UI while optimizing product pages to drive quick conversion decisions, like instant "Buy it now" flows and real-time inventory counts.

Problems identified

  • Mixed supplier imagery risked visual disunity
  • Default PDP layouts lacked stock indicators
  • Needed strong local delivery / trust cues
  • Large catalog vs. simple header navigation

Goals

  • Vibrant dark-mode aesthetic with brand gradient
  • Optimized PDP: pricing, variants, live stock, dual CTAs
  • Reinforce local delivery trust visually
  • Mobile-responsive, quick cart-to-checkout flow

Design decisions

A dark background (#0B0E17-tone) lets colorful product photography pop while staying sleek. Clean serif headings give product titles an upscale feel, balanced with crisp sans-serif body text. CTA hierarchy splits into an outlined "Add to cart" and a high-contrast filled "Buy it now," serving both multi-item shoppers and immediate buyers.

Gradient brand identity High-conversion PDP Live inventory badges Multi-angle gallery grid Trust-building delivery visuals

"A polished, cohesive presence that bridges local delivery trust with modern UI standards — reducing friction between discovery and checkout."

What I learnedSmall PDP details — live stock counts, dual CTA hierarchy — directly influence buyer confidence in multi-category stores.

DECODE — Sydney Construction Group Website Redesign

A concept redesign for Sydney's leading construction and engineering firm — establishing market authority, showcasing large-scale developments, and presenting multi-disciplinary capabilities.

Type
UI/UX Concept

Audience

Large construction firms often struggle to present dense technical portfolios, engineering specs, and multi-stage delivery models without overwhelming prospective developers. The challenge was simplifying capabilities spanning design management, full-scale construction, and post-construction delivery into an intuitive layout that highlights craftsmanship.

Problems identified

  • Full-spectrum capabilities needed a clear hierarchy
  • High-value projects needed clean gallery layouts
  • Safety standards and credibility needed visual grounding
  • Culture, leadership, and portfolio needed unified architecture

Goals

  • Modern aesthetic reinforcing construction authority
  • Cohesive multi-page layout across all key sections
  • Elevated project presentation via imagery grids
  • Clear path to inquiry and partnership touchpoints

Design decisions

A dark-theme framework gives the construction group a modern, high-tech, premium corporate identity. High-contrast typography and structured grids balance technical copy with large-format architectural visuals, while clean dividers and subtle motion cues guide visitors from trust indicators to project case studies.

Capabilities framework Interactive project portfolio Team & culture pages Insights / editorial layout Global navigation system

"A cohesive web platform that elevates DECODE's digital presence to match its status as a premier construction builder."

What I learnedBalancing industrial strength with visual clarity — structured spatial design and intuitive portfolio grids build immediate credibility with institutional clients.
